newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan-June foreign ship orders up 22 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan-June foreign ship orders up 22 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan received foreign orders for 155 vessels totalling 5.6 million gross registered tons (grt) in the first half of 1997, up 22 percent from the same period last year, an industry body said on Thursday.
The Japan Ship Exporters' Association attributed the year-on-year growth partly to increased contracts for very large crude carriers (VLCC).
Japan won eight VLCC orders during the January-June period, compared to four contracts a year ago.
Another major shipbuilder, South Korea, won orders for 92 vessels, representing 5.3 million grt, during the same period this year, an official for the association said.

Meanwhile, ship export contracts concluded by Japanese shipyards in June declined by 48 percent from a year ago to 566,400 grt, after May orders jumped by 242 percent from May 1996 to 1.2 million grt.
